scheme_name: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fee
other_conditions: Industries engaged in manufacturing and processing of textiles, apparel, and technical textiles products.
Unit must have started production on or after 1 April 2022.
Units may belong to private, co‑operative, joint sector or be owned/managed by the State Government.
Not applicable to non‑textile industrial units/enterprises.
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution.
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and an Eligibility Certificate issued by the Director of Textiles.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of 100% of the stamp duty and registration fee.
documents_required: Eligibility Certificate issued by the Director of Textiles
